scripts.build:pages: npm run build && vite build --outDir docs && cp docs/index.html docs/404.html && echo 'orendesignandbuild.com' > docs/CNAME && touch docs/.nojekyll && rm -rf production_files && cp -r docs production_files
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && git checkout -B gh-pages && cp -r docs/* . && git add -A && git commit -m 'Deploy latest build to GitHub Pages' && git push origin gh-pages --force && git checkout main
scripts.update-prod: npm run build && rm -rf production_files && cp -r dist production_files
